name: Transport means ownership indicator code
description: Code indicating the ownership of a means of transport.

values.name: Transport for the owner's account
values.description: Transport for the owner's account The owner of the transported goods is also the owner of the means of transport or rented it for this transport.

values.name: Transport for another account
values.description: Transport for another account The owner of the transported goods does not own the means of transport or has not rented it for this transport.

values.name: Private transport
values.description: Private transport A code indicating privately owned transport.
